title: 第115章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陆灵秀又说了说自己家中的近况。

她兄长陆誓当初从北地回来之后,好像六皇子知道了他跟苏落云有旧情，将他遣去了榷易院。

也算因祸得福，正好躲过这一劫,没有当成六皇子的亲信被抓。然而因为跟恒山王府有旧的缘故，现在榷易院的差事也维持不下去了，便跟吕应一样,跟着父亲做生意。

从陆灵秀的嘴里,苏落云倒是听到了许多新鲜事情。

毕竟陆家的买卖还在，如今京城百废待兴，许多店铺的店面还没有修缮好，就开始做起生意来了，陆家也是如此。

灵秀说着家中钱银周转时,倒是无意中提起了茂祥钱庄。

陆家老爷子因为买卖周转的缘故，须得通兑些银票子出来。可是走了附近的几个州县，那钱庄都说因为之前的战乱，钱庄的银库都将银子挪动走了,还需得船运解禁,才能将银子运回来，让他过几日再来。

陆灵秀说起这个,原是想要向落云打听一下,北地的船运何时解禁。

通兑不出银子来,陆家铺子许多买卖都要停滞了。

落云听了这话，却心念一动：若是战乱的时候,钱庄关门也情有可原。

可是现在百业待兴,许多店铺都已经陆续开始营业。可这钱庄却因为钱银周转不灵而支不出钱银来,简直让人匪夷所思。

要知道就算在战火纷飞的那一个月里,茂祥钱庄的生意也都照样开着,最起码东平王短缺了银子时，随时都可以去茂祥钱庄支到银子。

而且东平王还派了兵卒把守钱铺子，不让流民去打劫。

那时钱庄里的钱银都源源不断，为何偏在世道安定下来时，却拿不出钱银来了？

而且北地的船运什么时候封过？那钱庄的伙计压根就是胡说八道啊！

洛云听着听着眼睛微微一眯。

她突然灵光一闪，想到了会不会是那个游财神发觉情形不对，准备随时卷银子溜之大吉。

送走了陆灵秀之后，落云连忙去书房找韩临风，与他说了这事。

韩临风听了也沉吟了一下，其实游山樾那边，他一直派人盯着呢。

当初老崔给他送信儿，点出了游山樾两面三刀，玩两面派的真相，他就在附近的茂祥钱庄旁都安插了眼线。

不过这老头一如往常，照样游山钓鱼，并无什么异动。毕竟他也没有跟韩临风扯破了脸，无论怎么样，他都是当初资助铁面军的功臣。

不过落云分析得有道理。那钱庄突然借故不开门，的确是有要撤走的迹象。

那游山樾如此机敏，早早就要溜之大吉，实在出乎他的意料。

因为就在昨日，游山樾的书信刚刚送递到了京城，恭贺太子得偿所愿，拥戴着父亲为皇。

而且在信中，这老头子还对韩临风表白了一番心迹，表示会继续扶持太子，登上帝位成就大业。

想到那老头曾经出言轻薄过落云，又跟自己玩着两面三刀，韩临风脸色紧绷，准备派人连夜包抄，将这只肥耗子按在锅里。

可是落云却说：“茂祥钱庄开得遍地都是，许多商贾将自己的大半身家都存在了钱铺子里。那个老头子抓起来倒也容易。他风烛残年，可不怕死，若是破罐子破摔，藏匿了家产，让各地的钱庄子倒台破产，恐怕要在民间掀起轩然大波。民间生乱，都是因为百姓缺衣少食。如今父皇刚刚登基，大业除成，可不能生出这么大的乱子来。”

她是商贾出身，自然知晓这钱庄的重要性。

自从游山樾引起了她的注意后，她还派了许多柜上的老伙计打探，渐渐发现那游山樾的手里不光把持着钱庄，什么河运，贩盐林林种种，甚是驳杂，全都干系民生。

关于治国，落云不懂，不过还记得以前她眼盲的时候，韩临风曾经给她读过的书，其中便有“治大国如烹小鲜”的道理，要小心谨慎，如翻动鱼肉一般，免得把鱼肉给翻碎了。

她年少时，身处市井，也见过有些钱庄倒闭，逼死了小商人的事情。

那游山樾虽然一直隐在背后，却切实把持着大魏半壁江山的钱银命脉，如此颠簸，最伤害的是百姓，不得不慎重处理。

老鼠虽肥，却挟持了民生，不得不投鼠忌器些。

韩临风听着落云柔声细语地分析，也深思了良久。

在钱银方面，他麾下那些幕僚都不见得比太子妃通晓钱银账面，所以落云的忧虑并非杞人忧天，反而应该如她所言，对游山樾的处理慎之又慎。

“那依着你看，该如何处置这只奸猾的肥耗子？”

落云想了想，道：“他善于经营人脉，想必在各大官衙里都安插了眼线。当初东平王覆灭得如此快，一定出乎他的意料。老赌棍心慌了，怕自己满盘皆输。既然如此，就得给他亮亮牌，勾住他，不让他下赌桌。”

说到这，落云想了想，笃定道：“对游山樾不但不能冷落严惩，还要重重嘉赏，而且要赏得情真意切，敲锣打鼓，昭告天下！”

听她这么一说，韩临风立刻就明白了。

清醒的耗子不好抓，可是扔在米缸里吃撑了的耗子，只怕会翻着肚皮都不知道逃跑了！

想到这，韩临风冷哼了一声：“他与叛王传递的书信都在我手。通敌卖国，意图谋反，死罪难逃。一介商贾却包藏祸心，想要颠覆朝纲。这种人若是让他跑了，恐怕还要生乱。只是他难道不知道自己的事迹败露，会轻易落入圈套吗？”

落云琢磨着游山樾的为人，轻声道：“他虽然年岁大，又十分精明，但是骨子里还是江湖草莽的底子——记仇，睚眦必报，且喜好被人奉承。他后半生都在洗刷自己的黑底子，渴望被正道肯定。只要拿捏住了他这个短处，余下的便都好办了。这么肥的耗子，一定要抓他个出其不意，一滴油都不能浪费了……”

现在正是国库空虚的时候，而那些世家们的竹杠，暂且还敲不得。

Lu Lingxiu then talked about the current situation at home.

After her brother Lu Zhao came back from the North, it seemed that the Sixth Prince knew that he had an old relationship with Su Luoyun and sent him to Gueyiyuan.

It was a blessing in disguise. He just escaped this disaster and was not caught as a confidant of the Sixth Prince.However, because of the old relationship with the Hengshan Palace, the job at Queyi Yuan could no longer be maintained, so like Lu Ying, he followed his father in business.

From Lu Lingxiu's mouth, Su Luoyun heard many new things.

After all, the Lu family's business is still there. Nowadays, the capital is in dire straits. Many shops have started doing business before their storefronts have been repaired. The same is true for the Lu family.

When Lingxiu was talking about the money turnover at home, she accidentally mentioned Maoxiang Bank.

Due to the turnover of business, the old man of the Lu family had to exchange some silver notes.However, after visiting several nearby states and counties, the bankers all said that due to the previous war, the bank's bank vaults had moved the money away, and that shipping restrictions would have to be lifted before the money could be transported back, allowing him to come back in a few days.

When Lu Lingxiu talked about this, she originally wanted to ask Luo Yun when the shipping ban in the North would be lifted.

Without money to exchange, many transactions in Lu's shop will come to a standstill.

After hearing this, Luo Yun thought: If there is a war, it would be understandable for the bank to close its doors.

But now all kinds of businesses are waiting for prosperity, and many shops have begun to open one after another.But this bank cannot pay out money because of poor cash flow, which is simply unbelievable.

You must know that even during the month of war, the business of Maoxiang Bank was still open. At least when King Dongping was short of money, he could go to Maoxiang Bank to receive money at any time.

Moreover, King Dongping also sent soldiers to guard the money shop to prevent refugees from robbing.

At that time, there was an endless supply of money in the bank. Why was it that when the world was settling down, there was no money left?

And when was shipping in the Northland closed?That bank clerk is just talking nonsense!

Luo Yun narrowed his eyes slightly as he listened.

Suddenly she had a flash of inspiration, and she thought that maybe the wandering God of Wealth had noticed something was wrong and was ready to take the money and run away at any time.

After sending Lu Lingxiu away, Luoyun quickly went to the study to find Han Linfeng and told him about the matter.

Han Linfeng pondered for a moment after hearing this. In fact, he had been sending people to keep an eye on Youshanyue.

When Lao Cui sent him a letter, revealing the truth about You Shanyue's duplicity and double-dealing, he placed spies at the nearby Maoxiang Bank.

However, the old man continued to go fishing in the mountains as usual, and there was nothing unusual.After all, he didn't fall out with Han Linfeng. No matter what, he was still the hero who funded the Iron Mask Army in the first place.

But Luoyun's analysis makes sense.The bank suddenly closed its doors for some reason, and there were indeed signs that it was about to withdraw.

It was beyond his expectation that You Shanyue was so alert and wanted to escape so early.

Because just yesterday, You Shanyue's letter was delivered to the capital, congratulating the prince on achieving his wish and supporting his father as emperor.

Moreover, in the letter, the old man also expressed his feelings to Han Linfeng, saying that he would continue to support the prince and achieve great achievements in his ascension to the throne.

Thinking of the old man's frivolous remarks to Luoyun and his double-dealing with him, Han Linfeng's face tightened and he was ready to send people to outflank him overnight and pin the fat rat into the pot.

But Luo Yun said: "Maoxiang money shops are opening all over the place, and many merchants have stored most of their wealth in money shops. It is easy to catch that old man. He is in his dying years, but he is not afraid of death. If the jar is broken, it will be hidden."Hiding the family property and causing the bankruptcies of various places to go bankrupt will probably cause an uproar among the people.It is all because the people are short of food and clothing.Now that the emperor has just ascended the throne and his great achievements have been completed, we cannot cause such a big chaos."

She was born as a merchant, so she naturally knew the importance of this bank.

Since You Shanyue attracted her attention, she also sent many old clerks at the counter to investigate, and gradually discovered that You Shanyue not only controlled the bank, but also river transportation, salt sales, and other things, which were all related to people's livelihood.

Luo Yun didn't know much about governing the country, but she still remembered the book Han Linfeng had read to her when she was blind. There was a saying in it that "governing a big country is like cooking a small fish." She had to be careful, just like turning fish, so as not to break the fish.

When she was young, she was in the market and saw some banks going bankrupt and killing small businessmen.

Although You Shanyue has always been hidden behind the scenes, he actually controlled the money and lifeblood of half of the country in the Wei Dynasty. Such a bumpy situation would hurt the people the most, so it had to be dealt with carefully.

Although rats are fat, they have hijacked people's livelihood, so we have to be more cautious about rats.

Han Linfeng listened to Luoyun's soft analysis and pondered for a long time.

In terms of money, the staff under his command may not be as knowledgeable about money and accounts as the Crown Princess, so Luo Yun's worries are not unfounded. Instead, as she said, he should be cautious in handling You Shanyue.

"Then what do you think we should do with this cunning fat rat?"

Luo Yun thought for a while and said: "He is good at managing connections, and he must have spies in all the major government offices. It must have been beyond his expectation that King Dongping was destroyed so quickly. The old gambler was panicked, fearing that he would lose everything. In this case, we have to give him a bright card, hook him, and prevent him from playing at the gambling table."

Speaking of this, Luoyun thought for a while and said firmly: "Not only can we not neglect You Shanyue and severely punish him, we must also reward him heavily, and we must reward him sincerely. Beat the gongs and drums and tell the world!"

After hearing what she said, Han Linfeng understood immediately.

A sober rat is difficult to catch, but a full-fed rat thrown into a rice vat will turn its belly and not even know it is running away!

Thinking of this, Han Linfeng snorted coldly: "I have all the letters between him and the rebel king. Collaborating with the enemy and betraying the country, intending to commit rebellion, will inevitably lead to death. But a merchant has evil intentions and wants to subvert the imperial court. If such a person is allowed to run away, there will probably be chaos. But doesn't he know that his deeds will be exposed and he will easily fall into a trap?"

Luo Yun thought about You Shanyue's character and said softly: "Although he is old and very shrewd, he still has a rough and tumble heart - he holds grudges, retaliates, and likes to be flattered. He will spend the rest of his life.To cleanse oneself of the evil background and long to be affirmed by the right way, as long as you grasp his shortcomings, the rest will be easy to deal with.You must catch such a fat rat by surprise, and you must not waste a drop of oil..."

Now is the time when the national treasury is empty, and the rip-offs of those aristocratic families cannot be taken away for the time being.
